subject: Urgent: Offer negotiation for ML Lead — competing offer and band uplift request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.co>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.co>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.co>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.co>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Urgent: candidate situation — ML Lead (Michael Cho)

Team,

Quick summary: Michael (final candidate for ML Lead) just told our recruiter he has a competing verbal offer from Acme with a decision deadline end of day Thursday (3/18). He prefers Redwood but wants base closer to $240k and a guaranteed hire date in Q2. Our approved band for the role is $200k–$230k (midpoint $215k).

Request: can Finance approve an uplift to $235k base for this candidate (exception), and can we confirm start window and expedited approvals so we can get a signed offer before Thursday EOD? Recruiter says Michael will accept with a clear written top-line and DocuSign in hand.

I have attached the candidate offer v2 and a short comp-band summary. If we can approve, I will send an updated offer now and ask for signature. If not, we need to decide whether to hold or let him go.

Hannah
VP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

Attachments: offer_Michael_Cho_v2.pdf, comp_band_summary.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.co>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.co>
Date: Sun, 15 Mar 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Urgent: candidate situation — ML Lead (Michael Cho)

Hannah, Dev —

Thanks for the heads up. Need a short justification and total comp math (base, RSU grant, sign-on, bonus) to evaluate uplift. Also confirm if this is a one-off exception tied to candidate scarcity or if you're proposing a band change for the role.

Can you put numbers in a single row (current approved offer vs requested) and cc me by 1pm PST today. If it is strictly a one-time exception, we can accelerate sign-off with finance + CEO review. Band change requires a separate hc/band review.

—Marcus
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>
To: Michael Cho <michael.cho@example.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.co>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@mapletalent.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Mar 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Offer from Redwood Inference — ML Lead (updated)

Michael —

Really enjoyed our conversation last week. Attached is an updated written offer for the ML Lead role. Top-line: base $235,000, target annual cash bonus 15%, RSU grant (4-year vesting) valued at $90,000 at grant price, sign-on of $15,000 (prorated if start after May 1), and standard benefits. We can accommodate a start window between May 11–June 1; if you need an earlier date we can try to prioritize.

Please review and let me know if you have any questions — we can get the final DocuSign over once you confirm. I know you have a competing conversation at Acme; if you give us an ETA on signing we will hold the offer for you through Thursday EOD.

Best,
Dev Patel
Director, Machine Learning
Redwood Inference

Attachment: offer_Michael_Cho_v2.pdf

From: Michael Cho <michael.cho@example.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>
Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@mapletalent.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood Inference — ML Lead (updated)

Hey Dev —

Thanks for the updated offer. Very excited — Redwood is my top choice. A couple items before I sign:

- Base: can you move base to $245k? Acme's verbal is $250k base but lower equity, so I'd need closer to $245k to make numbers work.
- RSU vesting cliff: would you consider a 3-year vesting schedule instead of 4?
- Start date: I can do May 11 but will need agreement that onboarding will occur that week (I have two planned trips in late May).

I need to give Acme a response by Thursday EOD; if Redwood can get to $245k base or increase sign-on to $25k (instead of $15k) I'd sign immediately and send the DocuSign.

Appreciate you moving quickly.

—Michael

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.co>
To: Michael Cho <michael.cho@example.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.co>, Sarah Nguyen <sarah@mapletalent.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Mar 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood Inference — ML Lead (updated)

Michael —

Appreciate the clear asks and for prioritizing Redwood. We discussed with Finance and the hiring panel: we can approve a one-time exception to increase base to $240,000 (midpoint concession) and increase sign-on to $22,500. We cannot move to a 3-year RSU schedule (must remain 4-year standard). Start date May 11 is confirmed and we will have onboarding reserved that week.

If that works, Dev will send an updated DocuSign and we can keep the offer open through Thursday EOD as promised. Please confirm and we will get the paperwork out within 90 minutes.

—Hannah
VP, Talent Acquisition

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.co>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.co>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.co>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.co>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Final approval logged — HC-298 (Michael Cho)

Hannah/Dev/Marcus —

Finance has recorded the one-time exception in the HC tracker and routed the sign-off. I confirmed with Legal (standard terms), and the DocuSign link has been generated. I attached the DocuSign link stub for records. Please proceed to send the final signable offer.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/ABCDEF1234567890

Thanks — closing this out quickly made a difference.

Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: docusign_offer_link.txt
